MnMothlightWelcomeText: Hot supper. Dry socks. No whistling at the lamps.
MnMothlightHostText: I'm MARNIE. The cook's raspberry cake has vanished.
Everyone has an alibi. Most of them are asleep.
Have a look around? I refuse to accuse a lampshade twice.
MnMothlightRestText: Sit by the hearth. I'll put a fresh blanket over your team.
MnMothlightRestedText: There. Warm paws, full bellies. Take your time.
MnMothlightGuestText: I came for the ceiling. Then I saw the dessert cart.
Now I keep looking up and down. My neck's exhausted.
MnMothlightCookText: That cake had six layers. SIX.
If you find a guest six layers taller, send them over.
MnMothlightSleeperText: I'm not snoring. I'm keeping the moths away.
MnMothlightCrumbsText: Raspberry crumbs lead from the platter toward the bookcase.
MnMothlightBookText: A cookbook lies open: HOW TO HIDE A CAKE.
Every page after the title is blank.
MnMothlightFoundText: Behind the books: the cake, under a tea towel!
A note: KEEP THIS AWAY FROM ME UNTIL SUPPER. -THE COOK
MnMothlightSolvedText: His own handwriting! I'll let him break the news to himself.
Here. Something for the road. Before he hides that too.
MnMothlightFullText: Your PACK is full. I'll keep your treat right here.
MnMothlightAfterText: The cook says the culprit is very sorry.
He's also asking whether you'd like another slice.
MnMothlightHearthText: A great stone hearth. Someone has lined up six tiny pairs of drying socks.
MnMothlightMuralText: Painted moth wings open into stars, waves and orange morning light.
MnMothlightSignText: Supper beneath the stars. Even when it's raining.
